lead: This Sirah Nabawiyah application compiles narratives, chronological data, lineage, and significant events from authentic and recognized major sirah reference works.
title: Reference Books Consulted
intro: Here are the details of the historical and Hadith books serving as the foundation of this material:

cards.author: Sheikh Safiur-Rahman al-Mubarakpuri
cards.desc: First-prize winning Sirah book at the International Sunnah & Sirah Competition organized by the Muslim World League in Makkah. Serves as the primary chronological reference and section structure for this app.

cards.author: Abu Muhammad Abdul Malik bin Hisham (d. 218 AH)
cards.desc: A refined summary of Kitab al-Maghazi by Ibn Ishaq. It stands as the earliest and most authoritative complete Sirah work extant today.

cards.ttl: Zad al-Ma'ad fi Hadyi Khair al-'Ibad
cards.author: Imam Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyyah (d. 751 AH)
cards.desc: A monumental work encompassing the guidance, legal rulings, worship practices, leadership, and ethics of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in daily life and expeditions.

cards.author: Imam al-Bukhari & Imam Muslim
cards.desc: The most authentic Hadith collections serving as primary references to verify event details, sermons, physical descriptions, and companions' interactions.

cards.author: Imam Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Jarir at-Tabari (d. 310 AH)
cards.desc: Primary Islamic historical encyclopedia recording early narratives of prophetic history, Arab genealogy, and early Islamic milestones.

cards.author: Muhammad bin Yusuf as-Salihi ash-Shami (d. 942 AH)
cards.desc: One of the most extensive Sirah encyclopedias synthesizing reports from hundreds of earlier Sirah works.

methodology.title: Methodology Notes
points: 1. All content is adapted into clear and concise language for optimal readability on digital devices.
2. Page numbers and specific references cited refer to trusted translated editions.
3. This application serves as an educational introduction. For in-depth legal analysis and chain of narration, readers are advised to consult original texts with qualified scholars.
